test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 3x – 2y = 10 and xy = 11, the value of 27x³ - 8y³ is __________
solution:
Given:

3x - 2y = 10

xy = 11

Formula Used:

x3 - y3 = (x - y)³ +3xy(x - y) 

Calculation: 

⇒ (27x³ - 8y3) = (3x - 2y)3 + 3 × 3x × 2y × (3x - 2y) 

⇒ (27x3 - 8y3) = 1000 + 3 × 3 × 2 × 11(10)

⇒ (27x3 - 8y3) = 2980

**The correct answer is 2980.**
